title: Vocabulary: Places, Town & Directions
objective: Buildings, town facilities, streets and giving directions — a guaranteed PET speaking and writing theme.

items.meaning: the middle or busiest part of a city
items.example: The new library is in the city centre.
items.exampleZh: 新图书馆在市中心。

items.meaning: a place where two roads meet and cross
items.example: Turn left at the crossroads.
items.exampleZh: 在十字路口左转。

items.meaning: the way that someone or something goes or points
items.example: We were going in the wrong direction.
items.exampleZh: 我们走错了方向。

items.meaning: a door or place where you go in / leave a building
items.example: Meet me at the main entrance of the museum.
items.exampleZh: 我们在博物馆正门见面。

items.meaning: a building where people look at works of art
items.example: The gallery has a new exhibition of modern art.
items.exampleZh: 这家美术馆有一个新的现代艺术展。

items.meaning: a building with books and other materials for people to read or borrow
items.example: I study at the library because it's quiet.
items.exampleZh: 我在图书馆学习，因为那里安静。

items.meaning: a place where people buy and sell goods, often outside
items.example: We bought fruit at the Saturday market.
items.exampleZh: 我们在周六市场买了水果。

items.meaning: a building or statue built to remember an important person or event
items.example: The monument stands in the middle of the square.
items.exampleZh: 纪念碑矗立在广场中央。

items.meaning: a building where historical, scientific or artistic objects are shown
items.example: The science museum is popular with children.
items.exampleZh: 科学博物馆很受孩子们欢迎。

items.meaning: the hard path beside a road for people to walk on
items.example: Ride your bike on the road, not on the pavement.
items.exampleZh: 在马路骑车，别在人行道上骑。

items.meaning: an outdoor area where children can play
items.example: The school playground has a new climbing frame.
items.exampleZh: 学校操场添了新的攀爬架。

items.meaning: a circular place where roads meet and traffic goes round
items.example: Take the second exit at the roundabout.
items.exampleZh: 在环岛第二个出口驶出。

items.meaning: the way you go from one place to another
items.example: We chose a shorter route through the hills.
items.exampleZh: 我们选了穿过山丘的较短路程。

items.meaning: an open area in a town, often with buildings around it
items.example: Tourists take photos in the main square.
items.exampleZh: 游客们在主广场拍照。

items.meaning: a building where trains or buses stop
items.example: The bus station is next to the market.
items.exampleZh: 汽车站就在市场旁边。

items.meaning: a road in a town with buildings along it
items.example: Our school is on Park Street.
items.exampleZh: 我们学校在公园街。

items.meaning: an area of houses outside the centre of a town
items.example: They live in a quiet suburb of London.
items.exampleZh: 他们住在伦敦一个安静的郊区。

items.meaning: an office that gives visitors maps, advice and local information
items.example: We asked at the tourist information centre for a map.
items.exampleZh: 我们在游客信息中心要了一张地图。

items.meaning: a road that joins another road; a place where you turn
items.example: The restaurant is at the next turning on the left.
items.exampleZh: 餐厅在下一个左拐弯处。

items.meaning: a place where animals are kept for people to see
items.example: The zoo has a new area for tigers.
items.exampleZh: 动物园新开了一个老虎展区。

keyPoints: Give directions in order: go straight on, turn left/right, take the first turning, it's on your right.
Describe a town by places and facilities, then say what makes it convenient or interesting.
In notes and emails, spell place names carefully — examiners need to understand directions exactly.
